# Nifuda

> Nifuda keeps track of groceries, gadgets, tools and collections with location, quantity and value. Stored on your device, synced via iCloud if you like, no account needed.

Nifuda is a home inventory app for iPhone and iPad. Free download, Pro as a one-time purchase.

- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id6782342697
- Languages: Deutsch, English, Español, Français, Italiano, 日本語, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 한국어, Nederlands, Polski, Português (BR), Русский, Türkçe

## Features
- **Add an item in seconds.** Scan a barcode or type a name. Add quantity, price and location; batches keep track of purchase and expiry dates.
- **Organised your way.** Create your own tags and tag groups, by category or status. Lists bring together what belongs together.
- **Reminded in time.** Nifuda shows what expires soon and what drops below your minimum stock, so you know what's missing before you shop.
- **Know what it's worth.** Total value, value by location and what was used this month. Useful for insurance, moving house or simply staying on top of things.
- **More room for your inventory.** On iPad you see your entire inventory at a glance. With iCloud, iPhone and iPad stay in sync automatically.

## Privacy
- **No account** No sign-up, no email address, no password. Open the app and start.
- **No tracking** Nifuda contains no analytics or advertising tools. We can't see what you add.
- **Your iCloud** Data is stored on your device and, optionally, in your private iCloud. There is no Nifuda server.

## FAQ
### Do I need an account?
No. Nifuda works without sign-up. Your data lives on your device.

### Where is my data stored?
Locally on your iPhone or iPad. If you like, Nifuda syncs between your devices through your private iCloud.

### How much does Nifuda cost?
The download is free. Nifuda Pro unlocks every feature with a one-time purchase, no subscription.

### Can I export my inventory?
Yes, as a PDF report with values, quantities and locations, for example for your home insurance.

### Which devices does Nifuda run on?
iPhone and iPad. A Pro purchase applies to all devices using the same Apple ID.
